subject: craft
angle: How many extra invitations to print beyond the guest count
caption:
Clients always ask "how many extra cards do we need," and the right buffer is ten to fifteen.

· Keepsake copies for both sets of parents
· One pristine card reserved for the flatlay photographer
· Spares if ink smudges while writing guest names
· Backups for last-minute ninong additions

Send us your guest count over DM to check card samples.
